description: This file contains utility functions for handling ninja build commands related to precompiled headers, including generating filenames, writing flags, and managing output files for different toolchains (MSVC and GCC). It also includes functions to determine language-specific suffixes and extensions for precompiled headers.

methods.name: GetPCHLangSuffixForToolType
methods.description: Returns the language-specific suffix for precompiled header files based on the tool type.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHFile
methods.description: Computes the filename for the Windows precompiled header (.pch) for a given target and tool.

methods.name: WriteOneFlag
methods.description: Writes build flags for a target, handling precompiled headers and substitutions.

methods.name: GetPCHOutputFiles
methods.description: Determines the output files for precompiled headers based on target and tool.

methods.name: GetGCCPCHOutputExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension for GCC precompiled headers.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHObjectExtension
methods.description: Returns the object file extension for MSVC precompiled headers.
